profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer & Applied Scientist | Turning Computer Vision & Robotics Research into Robust 3D Estimation Systems | SLAM • Sensor Fusion • Calibration • Hangul | Ph.D.
profile.summary:
AWARD-WINNING STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER | APPLIED SCIENTIST | COMPUTER VISION & ROBOTICS
Staff-level software engineer and applied scientist with 20+ years of experience spanning advanced research, algorithm development, and production engineering across Computer Vision, Robotics, 3D Perception, Sensor Fusion, and Calibration. Proven track record of translating complex research problems into robust, high-performance systems deployed in real-world products.
• Computer Vision & 3D Perception: Deep expertise in multi-view geometry, feature detection and matching, image processing, scene understanding, localization, mapping, and visual perception.
• Estimation & Sensor Fusion: Extensive experience in robust estimation, state estimation, SLAM/VIO, sensor fusion, statistical learning, experimental design, and uncertainty modeling.
• Calibration & Systems Engineering: Hands-on expertise in camera, display, and sensor calibration; geometric and photometric modeling; validation; optimization; simulation; and production calibration systems.
• Research to Production: Experienced in taking algorithms from mathematical formulation and prototyping through software implementation, validation, optimization, and deployment in production environments.
• Technical Leadership: Cross-functional collaborator and technical leader with experience working across research, software, hardware, robotics, and product teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
Core Technical Areas
Computer Vision • Robotics • 3D/Multi-View Geometry • SLAM/VIO • Sensor Fusion • State Estimation • Robust Estimation • Calibration • Image Processing • Feature Detection & Matching • Machine Learning • Statistical Learning • Optimization • Experimental Design • Scene Understanding • Spectral Image Processing • Color Image Processing • Robotics Navigation & Control

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading development of production calibration algorithms, simulation frameworks, and AI-driven validation systems.
• Designed ValSimEst, a simulation–estimation–validation framework enabling scalable evaluation, regression testing, and performance analysis of calibration, localization, and perception algorithms using synthetic and real-world datasets.
• Developed computer vision algorithms for plane segmentation, geometric reconstruction, image undistortion, hinge-angle estimation, and camera calibration and improve their accuracy and robustness.
• Built robotic calibration and optimization pipelines integrating control inputs for high-precision calibration systems.
• Collaborated with hardware & manufacturing teams to transition research algorithms into production calibration systems.
• Contributed patent applications and established statistical evaluation methodologies for calibration performance analysis.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed production perception, localization, and calibration systems for HoloLens cameras, IMUs, and display systems.
• Invented the patented Spiral Feature Search algorithm for efficient calibration target acquisition. 
• Invented Blinkless Markerless Bi-phase Display Runtime Calibration, enabling display calibration without interrupting UX.
• Developed nonparametric camera distortion models for see-through visor calibration.
• Designed a calibration validation pipeline using the circular consistency between simulation and estimation.
• Collaborated across perception, firmware, hardware, and manufacturing teams to deliver end-to-end calibration solutions.

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.description: • Robotics: Model-based reinforcement learning and deep Kalman filter for legged robots.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Building 8 Project: Developing cutting-edge prototype and production software of scene understanding for augmented and virtual reality applications: color and depth camera calibration, 3D surface reconstruction and rendering, etc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed real-time tracking and visual-inertial sensor-fusion algorithms for mobile AR/VR systems.
• Developed an EKF-based visual-inertial state estimator fusing asynchronous camera and IMU measurements on mobile devices.
• Designed spline-based motion prediction to model continuous device motion between sensor updates and stabilize pose prediction.

positions.title: Enterpreneur
positions.description: • Technical Consulting: Designed intelligent control systems for autonomous vehicles and biomaterial inspection • Robust Estimation: Developed the least posterior entropy method for simultaneous model and data selection. • Language Education: Developed an efficient and effective Hangul acquisition method and system (https://hundli.com).

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.locationName: NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, USA
positions.description:
• UAS Localization: software architecture for multi-sensor fusion system, i.e., an octocopter equipped with LIDAR, radar, camera and IMU sensors. Asteroid Detection: An intelligent software capable of on-board detection of Near-Earth Asteroids based on temporal snapshots of pixel data of sky from infrared observations (Sep. 2014 ~ Oct. 2015).
• Rover Navigation: Structure and motion from stereo image sequences of an off-road-driving rover are reconstructed using the iterative closest point method for infrastructure-free navigation (May 2013 ~ Aug. 2014).
• 3D Terrain Reconstruction: Accurate digital elevation mosaics are reconstructed using the multi-grid shape from shading technique of planetary orbital images with Lunar-Lambertian reflectance model (May 2013 ~ Aug. 2014).

positions.title: NASA Postdoctoral Fellow
positions.locationName: NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, USA
positions.description:
• Rover Navigation: Developed a structure-from-motion algorithm to reconstruct the environment and rover motion from stereo image sequences for infrastructure-free navigation and off-road driving (Oct. 2012 ~ Aug. 2014).
• Terrain Reconstruction: Developed a multi-grid shape-from-shading algorithm with Lunar-Lambertian reflectance model for accurate digital elevation mosaics of planetary orbital images. • Multi-photogrammetry: Developed the Multiple View Pipeline (MVP) over the limitation of the Ames Stereo Pipeline to construct accurate, consistent digital elevation and image mosaics by exploiting multi-view geometry and photometry.  • Lunar Mapping and Modeling Project: Developed the photometric reconstruction of the lunar surface to reduce the effect of camera response function and create a more seamless, cosmetically appealing mosaic of ortho-images derived from Apollo 15 metric camera imagery (Mar. 2009 ~ May. 2014).

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description: • The photometric reconstruction of the lunar surface was developed to reduce the effect of camera response function and create a more seamless, cosmetically appealing mosaic of ortho-images derived from Apollo 15 metric camera imagery. A normality test of univariate data was developed and incorporated into outlier detection of Apollo Metric Imagery. The Lunar-Lambertian model was explored to recover the more realistic surface albedo. (Mar. 2009 ~ Apr. 2010).

positions.title: Invited Professor
positions.description: Delivered invited research and teaching activities in computer vision, image processing, and computational methods.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
• Developed a multiple camera calibration with no overlap, which will be used in intelligent surveillance systems. Also developed a probabilistic matching method based on the forward and backward selection method in linear regression models, of line segments for the homography of satellite and aerial images (Sep. 2007 ~ Mar. 2009). 
• Organized the Next Image Systems (NIS) Research Center for developing new concept of next generation in imaging and displaying systems to launch new projects (Sep. 2007 ~ Mar. 2009).

• Developed software for remote control of imaging sensors on UAVs, ensuring effective image manipulation.  
• Conducted thorough examinations of software systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

patents.title: Spiral Feature Search
patents.description: A computing system configured to identify a region of interest in an image having a plurality of pixels, each of which corresponds to a feature score. The region of interest is a section of the image where feature points reside. The computing system is also configured to traverse one or more pixels in the region of interest in a spiral sequence starting from a center of the region of interest to edges of the region of interest to determine whether the corresponding pixel is a feature point.
